_source: ConductionNL/opencatalogi development @f4241e445 lib/Settings/publication_register.json, schema publication 0.0.5, read 2026-10-10. Update this copy when OpenCatalogi changes the schema; the drift test then shows what Filinq must follow.

organization.description: Reference to the organisation that owns this publication, resolved against OpenRegister's shared organisation.
organization.title: Organization

themes.description: List of themes associated with this publication
themes.title: Themes

wooCategory.title: Woo information category
wooCategory.description: The information category of the Woo this publication is filed under. The sitemap of that category lists it for the national Woo index.

x-enum-labels.infocat003: Draft legislation sent out for advice
x-enum-labels.infocat007: Meeting documents of the States General
x-enum-labels.infocat008: Meeting documents of local and regional governments
x-enum-labels.infocat009: Agendas and decision lists of executive boards
x-enum-labels.infocat013: Subsidy obligations other than by decision

publicationDate.description: Publication date (WOO/DIWOO) — when set to a date in the past, this publication is live and publicly accessible
publicationDate.title: Publication Date

depublicationDate.description: Depublication date (WOO/DIWOO) — when set and in the past, this publication is withdrawn from public access. A future value schedules automatic depublication via the OpenRegister published-predicate.
depublicationDate.title: Depublication Date

retentionCategory.description: Selectielijst / WOO information-category reference that keys the statutory retention term (RET-003).
retentionCategory.title: Retention Category

retentionTermMonths.description: Statutory retention term in months, counted from the publication date (RET-003).
retentionTermMonths.title: Retention Term (Months)

retentionAction.description: Action taken when the retention term expires: review (flag only), depublish (set depublicationDate), or archive (lifecycle transition) (RET-003).
retentionAction.title: Retention Action

retentionExpiresAt.description: Computed retention expiry = publication date + retentionTermMonths. May be manually overridden, in which case retentionNote is required (RET-003).
retentionExpiresAt.title: Retention Expires At

retentionNote.description: Legal basis or exception rationale for the retention decision; mandatory when retentionExpiresAt is manually overridden or extended (RET-003).
retentionNote.title: Retention Note

retentionLastEvaluatedAt.description: Idempotency marker recording the date the retention evaluation job last actioned this publication (RET-005).
retentionLastEvaluatedAt.title: Retention Last Evaluated At

status.description: Lifecycle status of the publication; the archived state retains the object internally while removing it from every public surface (RET-006).
status.title: Status

plooiStatus.description: Whether this publication reached PLOOI, the delivery API of open.overheid.nl: delivered or failed. Empty until a catalogue with PLOOI delivery on delivers it.
plooiStatus.title: PLOOI status

plooiDeliveredAt.description: When the PLOOI delivery was last attempted.
plooiDeliveredAt.title: PLOOI delivered at

plooiIdentifier.description: The identifier PLOOI gave this publication.
plooiIdentifier.title: PLOOI identifier

plooiReason.description: Why the last PLOOI delivery failed, as the platform or the connection said it.
plooiReason.title: PLOOI failure reason
